statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release; see https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5932. The docker-engine APK ships dockerd built from Moby 29.7.2, which vendors github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto for OpenPGP and does not import golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp. go version -m on the published dockerd binary lists golang.org/x/crypto v0.55.0 as a module dependency but no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp import path, so the advisory OpenPGP code is not present in the shipped artifact.

GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree, which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release; see https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5932. The docker-engine APK ships dockerd built from Moby 29.7.2, which vendors github.com/ProtonMail/go-crypto for OpenPGP and does not import golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp. go version -m on the published dockerd binary lists golang.org/x/crypto v0.55.0 as a module dependency but no golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp import path, so the advisory OpenPGP code is not present in the shipped artifact.

GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. Analysis of this image's shipped Go binaries found no import or link of golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp; the vulnerable OpenPGP code is therefore not present in the shipped artifacts (vulnerable_code_not_present).
